response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with strong backend, web, and systems programming credentials, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js, JavaScript, and DLang web/backend platforms rather than C++. His only substantive C++ experience is a single ~6-month role in 2014-2015 and a bachelor thesis project, with no evidence of recent architecture-level C++ work, IEC 62443 security standards, IoT/MQTT protocols, or industrial automation domain exposure required by this role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, mobile, and distributed systems (15+ years)
Demonstrated strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, open-source leadership
Experience with networked/low-latency systems (DLang, async I/O, microservices at Sociomantic)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (single short stint ~10 years ago) and not recent or central to his career
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards experience
No mention of MQTT, REST-based IoT, UML, or industrial automation/protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and architecture skill set
